model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 養吉齋叢錄 j18, modern studies of 绮春园, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings; 日下旧闻考 does not cover this garden, and Jiaqing's 三十景 poems could not be reached (wishlist).
